• Added Top Toolbar '🔐 Premium VPN' Global Control Center (replacing '🥷 Team') to connect or disconnect ('🔐 Premium VPN (Login)' / '🌐 Direct / VPN Off') the entire SGB Browser v2 (all Profile Manager browsers + Bots #1–#7) in 1 click, with 2-way sync with Bot #7.
• Added Official Premium VPN Login System (Surfshark 6-Digit Login Code / QR Code / Official Chrome Extension Auth & Manual Service Credentials, plus NordVPN, PIA, Windscribe, CyberGhost, ProtonVPN, IPVanish & Custom Gateway).
• Upgraded Premium VPN Rotation Engine to 58+ Individual Physical Servers per Country (e.g. it-mil-v001..v065 & it-rom in Italy, 50–150+ in US/UK/DE/FR) with a 100% Non-Repeating Shuffled Server Deck ('recent_assigned_ips'), Auto-Rotate Timer (1m / 2m / 3m / 5m / 10m / Fixed), 1-click '🔄 Rotate', and full 8-indicator '📡 PROXY TELEMETRY & PERSISTENCE HUD' sync.

• Added Universal '⏸ Pause' / '▶ Resume' control button immediately before 'Stop' / 'Stop All' across all bots (Bots #1–#7, Number Filter & Proxy Checker) with live in-place checkpoint pause & resume.
• Restored 100% Official srBrowser v2.0.37 Bot #1 (01_fb_account_creator) engine — all 10 exact official .srx binaries preserved on disk & zero runtime overrides (pure SGB Browser visual branding & free access only).
• Restored 100% Official Custom Proxy & Built-in Auto VPN flow in Browser Method 5 & Emulator Creator.
• Added High-Speed Internal Facebook Number Filter in Bot #7 (Headless GraphQL CAAFBAccountSearchViewQuery Engine), smart '🔑 Password' modal, End-to-End Number + Paired OTP Auto-Recovery, and Valid_Numbers exporter.
